name: Bromochlorophen
description: Bromochlorophen (CAS 15435-29-7 ) is a halogenated bisphenol antimicrobial active used across pharmaceutical, personal care, and water treatment applications. It delivers broad-spectrum biocidal activity against bacteria and fungi. This chemical serves as a reliable preservative and disinfectant ingredient in various formulated products. In personal care and cosmetic formulations, it is incorporated to protect creams, lotions, and cleansing preparations. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as an antimicrobial active in topical preparations and as an intermediate in the synthesis of more complex active compounds. It ensures product stability and safety during storage. Water treatment operations employ it for its biocidal properties in controlling microbial growth in industrial water systems and process fluids. It is highly effective in maintaining hygiene in large-scale industrial environments. It also functions as an antimicrobial agent in industrial cleaning and disinfection formulations where halogenated phenolic actives are specified. This versatility makes it a staple in heavy-duty sanitation protocols. Bromochlorophen is typically supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. Packaging options generally range from laboratory-scale quantities through to bulk industrial supply, depending on supplier capability.
